topic: Things we value & pronoun traps（珍惜的事物＋代名詞陷阱 it / one / them）

shadow.speaker: Tsai Ing-wen 蔡英文（2020 NDI Celebration of Democracy Gala 視訊致詞, 2020-12-08 US EST）

chunks.text: I know that these exercises are always precious.
They remind us about the lengths to which we must go to protect our democracies, freedoms and way of life.
This is not the least because throughout so much of history,
the right of people to choose their own leaders has been the exception rather than the norm.

phrases.en: the exception rather than the norm

respond.prompt_en: What is something precious to you that you never want to take for granted? Answer in one sentence.
respond.prompt_zh: 有什麼東西對你很珍貴、你不想把它視為理所當然？用一句英文回答。（可以用 It reminds me of… 或 …is precious to me because…）

vocab.example: Time with my grandparents is precious to me.
vocab.note: be precious to sb。別和 previous（先前的）、precise（精確的）搞混！蔡總統原句：these exercises are always precious.

vocab.example: This photo reminds me of our trip to Kenting.
vocab.note: 會考陷阱：remind sb of + N（使想起）／remind sb to + V（提醒去做）／remind sb about + N（提醒某事）。

vocab.example: Everyone passed the test, with the exception of Ken.
vocab.note: with the exception of = except（除了…）；the exception rather than the norm（例外而非常態）；形容詞 exceptional＝傑出的。

vocab.example: Wear a hat to protect your face from the sun.
vocab.note: protect A from B（保護 A 免於 B）；名詞 protection。

vocab.zh: 把…視為理所當然（而不珍惜）
vocab.example: We often take clean water for granted until the tap stops working.
vocab.note: B2 必會片語；for 不能省。也可說 take it for granted that + 子句。

grammar.title: 代名詞陷阱：it / one / they・them / ones
grammar.explain:
會考最愛考「指的是哪一個」：
① it＝前面提過的「同一個」東西，或一整件事。
② one＝同一類裡「隨便一個」，等於 a/an + 單數名詞。
③ they / them＝前面提過的「那些」（特定的複數）。
④ ones＝同一類裡的「一些」（不特定的複數），常說 the red ones。
🔑 判斷法：問自己「是同一個嗎？」是 → it / them；只是同一種 → one / ones。
⚠️ 陷阱：「喜歡／討厭做某件事」的那件事，要用 it，不是 one 或 them（113 會考就考過）。
examples: I know that these exercises are always precious. They remind us… —— 蔡總統原句：They＝these exercises（特定的複數）
I lost my umbrella, so I bought a new one. —— 不是同一把，只是同一種 → one
I lost my umbrella, but Dad found it in the car. —— 找回來的是同一把 → it
These shoes are too small. Do you have bigger ones? —— 同一種、不特定的複數 → ones

practice.question: My phone is really old and slow. I want to get a new ___ for my birthday.
practice.explanation: 想要的是「一支新的」手機，不是原本那支 → one（= a phone）。如果是 'I dropped my phone and broke ___.' 就要用 it。

uoe.passage: My grandma gave me an old watch on my tenth birthday. It isn't expensive, but it is very ___1___ to me. Every time I look at ___2___, it reminds me ___3___ the summers we spent together. Last week my friend laughed and said, "Your watch is so old! Why don't you buy a new ___4___?" I just smiled. Some things can't be replaced.

gaps.explanation: precious to me＝對我很珍貴。previous＝先前的、precise＝精確的，都是長得像的陷阱字。
看的是「同一支」奶奶給的錶 → it。
remind sb of + N＝讓某人想起…。remind sb to 後面要接原形動詞。
朋友說買「一支新的」錶，不是原本那支 → one（= a watch）。

quiz.question: Buses to the airport only come once every hour, and we just missed ___. Why don't we take a taxi?
quiz.explanation: 錯過的是「一班」公車（不特定的一班）→ one。這題 111 會考答對率只有約 31%！it 要指特定那一班，them 是複數。

quiz.question: Chris loves walking with Anna on snowy days, but Anna hates ___ very much.
quiz.explanation: Anna 討厭的是「在下雪天散步」這件事 → it 指一整件事。

quiz.question: It almost killed Kevin to take care of his baby sister for one afternoon. He wondered how his mom could do ___ every day.
quiz.explanation: 媽媽每天做的是「照顧妹妹」這件事 → it。不是 her（do her 不合理）。

quiz.question: Before I went to bed, Mom reminded me ___ the lights in the living room.
quiz.explanation: remind sb to + V＝提醒某人去做某事。remind sb of 是「使想起」，意思不同。

quiz.question: Many people take their health ___ until they get sick; then they realize how precious it is.
quiz.explanation: take sth for granted＝把…視為理所當然，for 不能省。

quiz.question: In Tsai Ing-wen's speech: "the right of people to choose their own leaders has been the ___ rather than the norm."
quiz.explanation: the + 名詞 → exception（例外）。the exception rather than the norm＝例外而非常態（原聲跟讀的句子）。

dialog.greet: Hi Roby! 我是蔡老師 😊 今天的主題是「珍惜的事物」，還有會考超愛考的 it / one / them。Ready?
dialog.present: 先跟著原聲唸一遍，再學 5 個單字和一個代名詞小陷阱。Let's go!
correct: Nice job, Roby! 你抓到重點了！
Spot on! 這題很多人會錯，你沒有 😎
wrong: Not quite. 沒關係，再看一下提示 💪
Almost! 想想：是「同一個」還是「同一種」？
Oops! 錯了也是在學習，再試一次～
dialog.hint: 小提示：同一個 → it / them；同一種 → one / ones。
dialog.submit: Ready to check? 送出前再檢查一次喔！
dialog.done: Well done, Roby! 今天的 it / one 陷阱你都會了 🎉 See you tomorrow!
